reply.text:
That's a real cost, and plenty of people feel it. The good news is you don't need a membership to keep training well. A home setup with a pair of adjustable dumbbells, a band or two, and a pull-up bar covers most of what a gym does, and bodyweight and outdoor sessions work too.

If you want to go that route, tell me what you'd have on hand and I'll build a block around it. Or if you're staying put for now, I can make your sessions tighter so every visit earns its price.
